get.description: The signed-in session. Needs the access token (`Authorization: Bearer` or `DPoP`).

401.description: No valid access token, or the session has ended

post.description: Starts a draft as the signed-in account: with `copyOf`, a copy of that published version under the next minor version marked `-draft` (`2.0.0` gives `2.1.0-draft`), its artefacts as they were; otherwise a blank new package from `name`, `kind`, `title`, `version` and `canonical`. Needs `metadata.author`.

409.description: That version is drafted or published already

422.description: A field is missing or not valid

get.summary: Documents and serves the package list.
get.description: The Studio's package list (central only): one row per package, its newest version, with the actions the signed-in person may take and why each other one is refused. Needs a `metadata.*` or `configuration.activate` permission.

get.summary: Documents and serves one package version's page.
get.description: One package version read from top to bottom: what changed against the previous published version, the stored check results, who must act and the history.

get.summary: Documents and serves one file of a package version.
get.description: One file of a package version, for an editor, with the draft's revision as the `ETag` to send back as `If-Match` when saving.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The file's path in the package, e.g. `Questionnaire-anc-visit.json`

404.description: No such package version or file

put.summary: Documents and saves one file of a draft.
put.description: Writes one file of a draft (a new one is added) and repacks the draft. `If-Match` must carry the revision read (the `ETag`): a save without it, or after someone else's, is refused with 412 and nothing is kept. `package.json` keeps its name and version; the version changes through `PUT …/version`. Needs `metadata.author`. Answers the page as it is now.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The file's path in the package

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The draft's revision, as its ETag

200.description: Saved; the page as it is now

409.description: The draft is no longer in Draft

412.description: If-Match is missing or stale: reload

422.description: The file or its path cannot be saved in the package

delete.summary: Documents and removes one file of a draft.
delete.description: Removes one file of a draft and repacks it, with `If-Match` as for a save. `package.json` and the manifest stay. Needs `metadata.author`.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The file's path in the package

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The draft's revision, as its ETag

200.description: Removed; the page as it is now

404.description: No such package version or file

409.description: The draft is no longer in Draft

412.description: If-Match is missing or stale: reload

put.summary: Documents and changes a draft's version.
put.description: Gives a draft another version until it is submitted, where the semver check confirms it: `package.json` and the manifest take it, and the draft becomes `name@version` with its history. `If-Match` as for a save. Needs `metadata.author`. Answers the page under its new id.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The draft's revision, as its ETag

200.description: Renumbered; the page under its new id

409.description: Not in Draft, or that version is drafted or published already

412.description: If-Match is missing or stale: reload

post.summary: Documents and takes one lifecycle step.
post.description: Takes one lifecycle step as the signed-in account, checked again here whatever the list said: the permission, the stage, the Draft Holder and the separation of duties. `request-changes` needs a `reason`, `activate` a `scope` (`national`, `district:<code>`, `facility:<code>` or `program:<facility>:<program>`). `check` (*Check now*) runs validation and simulation on a draft and keeps the results, leaving it in Draft. `hand-over` offers the draft `to` a username, who holds it once they `accept-handover`; `decline-handover` calls the offer off. `reassign` (`metadata.manage`) gives it `to` a username at once, for a `reason`. `withdraw` ends an unpublished draft and keeps it under another id, freeing its `name@version`. Answers the page as it is afterwards, under the id it is kept as.

200.description: Done; the page as it is now

404.description: No such package version or step

409.description: The lifecycle refused the step, or it changed meanwhile

422.description: A reason, a scope or who it goes to is missing or not valid
